obligations.expected_behavior: When a Skill is classified as routing/orchestration, provide a linked ASCII decision diagram.
forbidden_result: The routing/orchestration Skill has no linked ASCII decision diagram.
obligations.observable_result: The Skill record or documentation contains a link to an ASCII decision diagram.
obligations.state_after: A linked ASCII decision diagram is present for the routing/orchestration Skill.
obligations.state_before: The routing/orchestration Skill's linked decision diagram has not been established.
obligations.subject: Routing/orchestration Skill
obligations.trigger: When authoring or validating a routing/orchestration Skill.

obligations.expected_behavior: The linked ASCII decision diagram declares reachable branch IDs that include all three primary example routes.
forbidden_result: Any of the three primary example routes is absent from the declared reachable branch IDs.
A declared reachable branch remains unresolved.
obligations.observable_result: Each of the three primary example routes is represented by a declared reachable branch ID in the linked diagram.
obligations.state_after: The diagram declares reachable branch IDs for all three primary example routes.
obligations.state_before: Reachable branch coverage for the three primary example routes has not been verified.
obligations.subject: Routing/orchestration Skill decision diagram
obligations.trigger: When validating the linked decision diagram's reachable branches.

obligations.expected_behavior: Acceptance verification fails when a routing/orchestration Skill is missing its required linked ASCII decision diagram.
forbidden_result: Acceptance passes a routing/orchestration Skill with a missing linked ASCII decision diagram.
obligations.observable_result: The verification result is failure for a missing diagram.
obligations.state_after: The acceptance result records failure when the required diagram is missing.
obligations.state_before: Diagram presence is being checked and may be absent.
obligations.subject: Acceptance verification for routing/orchestration Skills
obligations.trigger: During acceptance verification of a routing/orchestration Skill.

obligations.expected_behavior: Acceptance verification fails when any declared reachable branch is unresolved.
forbidden_result: Acceptance passes while a declared reachable branch remains unresolved.
obligations.observable_result: The verification result is failure for every unresolved declared reachable branch encountered.
obligations.state_after: The acceptance result records failure whenever a declared reachable branch is unresolved.
obligations.state_before: Declared reachable branches are being checked for resolution.
obligations.subject: Acceptance verification of declared routing branches
obligations.trigger: During acceptance verification of the routing/orchestration Skill's declared reachable branches.

obligations.expected_behavior: A real leaf Skill is explicitly treated as not applicable to the routing/orchestration diagram requirement, and no decision diagram is required for it.
forbidden_result: A real leaf Skill is required to provide a routing decision diagram solely because of this requirement.
A real leaf Skill lacks an explicit not-applicable treatment.
obligations.observable_result: The Skill classification or validation record explicitly marks a real leaf Skill as outside this requirement's applicability.
obligations.state_after: The real leaf Skill is explicitly not applicable and is exempt from the diagram requirement.
obligations.state_before: Applicability of the routing/orchestration diagram requirement for the Skill has not been established.
obligations.subject: Real leaf Skill
obligations.trigger: When validating a Skill that is a real leaf Skill.

obligations.expected_behavior: Acceptance verification fails when a Skill declared as routing/orchestration is falsely classified as a leaf Skill.
forbidden_result: Acceptance passes a routing/orchestration Skill under a false leaf classification.
obligations.observable_result: The verification result is failure for a false leaf classification when routing is declared.
obligations.state_after: The acceptance result records failure for the false leaf classification.
obligations.state_before: The Skill's routing declaration and leaf classification are being checked for consistency.
obligations.subject: Acceptance verification of leaf classification
obligations.trigger: When a Skill has declared routing/orchestration behavior and its leaf classification is validated.
